capabilities: Run hybrid semantic, BM25, and graph-boosted retrieval over vault notes
Discover unlinked note pairs with high similarity and suggest missing links
Warn about contradictions with LLM-backed citations in a sidebar
Expose vault query tools to AI agents via MCP over stdio and HTTP/SSE
Incrementally sync and reindex notes after edits
extras: The Obsidian plugin is a companion to a separately installed Python engine; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and detailed plugin docs live at docs/subsystems/obsidian-plugin.md rather than in the README.
problem: Obsidian's search is keyword-based and its graph only shows explicit links, so semantically related but unconnected notes and contradictions stay hidden.

relations.evidence: Serves as a high-precision retrieval data plane for AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode)
Swap between Ollama, OpenAI, Groq, or local endpoints

requires.name: PKMRAG Python engine (installed via pipx or uv)
API key for OpenAI or Groq (Ollama and local endpoints need none)

summary: Local-first hybrid GraphRAG engine and MCP server that adds semantic retrieval, missing-link discovery, and contradiction warnings to a vault.
